description:
Integrate the Lottie animation library into the 'BasicApp' project and replace the static TextView with an animation.

1. Add the Lottie dependency 'com.airbnb.android:lottie:6.3.0' (or newer) to the app module's build.gradle.kts.
2. Import the provided animation file from '/home/ga/Documents/assets/android_wave.json' into the project's raw resources directory (create 'app/src/main/res/raw' if needed).
3. In 'activity_main.xml', replace the existing TextView with a 'com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView'.
4. Configure the view to display the 'android_wave' animation and loop indefinitely (using 'lottie_loop="true"' or 'lottie_autoPlay="true"').
5. Verify the project builds successfully.
